name: Humlebaek in a day
description_md:
Humlebaek in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Humlebaek in DK.

The route covers 9.1 km of walking between stops and includes 5 sightseeing stops. The full day takes about 7.9 hours, with the visit time at each stop included.
